help:
Usage: cli [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Autoengineering: AI-assisted systems engineering for complex model chains.

Options:
  --version  Show the version and exit.
  --help     Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  agents       Run bounded worker workflows with fake or explicitly...
  campaign     Run deterministic campaigns with supplied trusted adapters.
  candidates   Scaffold a candidates YAML for a component (fill in via deep...
  components   List all components in the system.
  describe     Print a description of the system.
  experiments  Render a saved experiment tree (autoresearch.jsonl).
  graph        Print the system as a Mermaid diagram.
  improve      Run the bounded auto-research loop over candidate replacements.
  optimize     Run or resume a configured whole-system optimization study.
  report       Generate an analysis report from validation results.
  validate     Validate a component against baseline data.
